subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Identificar argumentos principais e as evidências/exemplos que os sustentam.

components.description_pt: Determinar a afirmação central em texto argumentativo usando recursos multimodais
components.description_en: Determine the central claim in an argumentative text using multimodal resources
components.cc_component_description: Determine the central claim in an argumentative text using multimodal resources

components.description_pt: Identificar evidências usadas para sustentar argumento principal em um texto
components.description_en: Identify evidence used to support a main argument in a text
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between a speaker's claims and the evidence used to support them

components.description_pt: Identificar exemplos fornecidos para reforçar argumentos em um texto
components.description_en: Identify examples provided to reinforce arguments in a text
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between an author's main point and the reasons provided to support it

components.description_pt: Explicar a relação entre afirmação, evidência de apoio e raciocínio
components.description_en: Explain the relationship between a claim, supporting evidence, and reasoning
components.cc_component_description: Explain the relationship between a claim, supporting evidence, and reasoning

cc_matches.description:
Multilingual learners will construct social studies arguments that
* Introduce topic
* Select relevant information to support claim with evidence
* Show relationship between claim, evidence and reasoning

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán interpretar argumentos para...
*determinar afirmaciones
* evaluar el razonamiento y evidencia clara, relevante y confiable de afirmaciones
* identificar lenguaje que crea un estilo formal
* comprender la lógica y estrategia de razones y evidencia
* reconocer el uso de textos multimodales y translingüísticos con atención a diversas
audiencias
* discernir las declaraciones hechas por el autor
Identify the reasons and evidence a speaker provides to support particular points.
With prompting and support, identify the reasons an author gives to support points in a text.
